election._note: Elected 1 October 2022 for a four-year term; polling day is fixed to the first Saturday of October, so the next falls on 3 October 2026. Wikipedia, 'Next Latvian parliamentary election'.

dissolution._note: The Satversme has no self-dissolution vote: the Saeima dissolves by national referendum -- initiated by one third of the electorate (Art. 14) or proposed by the President and put to the vote (Art. 48) -- where more than half vote for dissolution (Art. 15). The machinery's self_dissolution reads that referendum-initiated mechanism. Satversme, Arts. 14-15, 48.

head_of_state._note: The President, elected by the Saeima for four years -- the indirect one among the Baltic presidencies; the incumbent was elected in May 2023, so the next falls due in 2027, at a sitting the Saeima schedules. Ceremonial but with a suspensive veto and a real role in government formation. Wikipedia, 'President of Latvia'.
head_of_state.title: President

amendment._note: Arts. 76-77: the Satversme amends by a 2/3 vote of the Saeima at a sitting where at least 2/3 of its members are present. Art. 77 makes Articles 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 77 itself amendable only by referendum, which the template's two_thirds rule cannot express; recorded below. Satversme, Arts. 76-77.
amendment._referendum_note: Art. 77's list -- sovereignty, territory, the state language, the flag, the democratic electoral order -- is a mandatory-referendum list, the sharpest of this block's Baltic clauses; ordinary amendments read none and the gap is this note. Satversme, Art. 77.
amendment._permits_system_change_note: Articles 1-3 put the democratic republic and the sovereign territory behind Art. 77's referendum bar, and Latvian practice treats them as beyond ordinary revision -- flagged as convention rather than a written eternity clause.

judicial._note: Satversmes tiesa, Art. 85: reviews the conformity of laws and other enactments with the Satversme. Latvijas Republikas Satversme, Art. 85.

formation._note: The President names a candidate Prime Minister, who presents the Government and its programme and must win the Saeima's confidence (Art. 59) -- but the government that wins is a multi-party bargain, Latvia having governed by ever-shifting coalitions since 1991 with among Europe's highest government turnover, and the machinery's coalition_negotiation names that bargaining phase rather than a single investiture ritual. The Government stands while it holds the Saeima's confidence. Satversme, Arts. 55-59.

government._pretender_note: Whom data/laws/amendments.json's Restoration Act puts on the throne. Authored per nation because the law is generic and the dynasty is not; a monarchy points this at its own sitting monarch.

fiscal._note: General government, IMF/OECD estimates ~2024, rounded, on the same conventions as AUT.json's block. VAT 21% is the statutory standard rate; corporate 20% is the statutory rate; income 21 is a blend of the 20/31 two-band schedule; capital gains 20% is the 2024 personal rate. Debt ~47.5% and revenue ~30.5% of GDP (Eurostat 2023-2024). Spending is the general-government split scaled to expenditure near 37% of GDP; defence 3.2% is the 2024 outlay, briefly the highest share in the Baltics; health 3.7% is Latvia's famously thin public provision.
